reviews_5s:
Arrived as promised. Packaged well. I opened it up and was impressed. This is just what I wanted. Even has extra rubber gaskets to use if needed. 😁These are really nice to store sugar and flour also macaroni!! I bought smaller ones but these are prefect size and keeps food fresh!!Very good product exactly what I needed can't get any betterMy pantry looks great. Moves to all glass in my pantry and these are perfectWell made, love the marker and labels and cute jar shape. I highly recommend.Beautiful. Arrived well packaged. works and looks awesome. My only complaint is that the included labels are a little small for this size jar.Absolutely love these for sourdough starter!Excellent quality. Would buy again.I love these jars. I put spices in them garlic, onion, pepper, teas, all kinds of things.
They do seal very nicely. The glass is a non-toxic glass.

The thing, however, I must say about the closure, is that it isn't as heavy duty as they were in the old days. What I mean is, is that the old jars from way back when were very heavy duty-- the metal parts that clamp it on there. Now the metal that does the clamping is adequate and seems to do a good job, but don't expect that super thick, heavy steel that your grandmother used to use.

Lastly, the jars are true to size they fit what they say they'll fit. They do come with white marker and labels. I have purchased them three times. All of the jars are functioning well and sealing well at this time. My first purchase was a couple of years ago. Like, if I helped you find tour next best glass jars.Love these they seal real good , the perfect size and no worries if they fall over accidentally
reviews_1s:
1 out of the six of the jars, had a serious manufacture flaw. It had a star shape crack that was from an obvious improper manufacture process. Then got past quality control. It was so obvious to me I spotted it as I was pulling them out of the box. The reason for the 3 on the review, is they did pack it will, this was just a manufacturing flaw. The other jars so far seem okay. We'll see if the company actually does anything about it.
UPDATE (same day) Took a closer look and found a second jar that the lid has a large chip of glass missing!!! So reduced to 1 star now. We'll see if the company responds, I doubt it after reading many of the 3 to 1 star reviews..My expectations are higher than most. I spend hours cooking each day. I rely on high quality, efficient, well made products to enhance my culinary experience. Unfortunately I returned these. Why?
I based my review on what I know. Glass equal to or higher than mason/ ball canning jar glass; their basic clarity, function, reliable glass holds up for hard work in the kitchen for years. Not equal to ball or mason.
The thickness of the glass was light and might break with everyday use in the middle of preparing quality meals. Deal breaker for me. I need durable tools. I saw a review stating easy breakage and a bought these anyway to save money. Humm
These may be fine if you don’t cook much or expect to use them often. I want beautiful glass container storage I can trust to house ingredients for safe use on demand. No fooling around. What is the weird round raised circle on top of the lid?
If you want to look at a craft you put in this jar from a distance these are fine.
I will be spending a lot more to get the quality everyday rough and tumble jar storage use with ease and joy in the kitchen.
Best to each of you. High ratings led me here.
I didn’t expect this journey to be so complicated, or costly. You get what you pay for.All I received was a pile of broken glass. The outside box was perfectly fine and untouched makes you wonder,do not buy these.1 broken cover. Didn't get to use it yetok if they arrive .. half of mine were broken..WOUD NOT RECOMMEND!!! I use these for my overnight oats. Loved the wide mouth and the seal. Problem is out of the 6 - 4 of them have shattered just by using a spoon to stir them. I'd recommend looking for something else for a storage container.When I opened the package I thought everything looked great. Then I looked closer and all 4 jars had flaws. One jar had a chip on the bottom that appeared to be a bubble in the glass that broke at the surface. The other 3 jars all had 1-2 (1/8-1/4” dia.) bubbles in the sides of the jars that were unbroken but meant don’t use these for canning or to put hot liquids into them. Chances are they would shatter.I was so excited to use these for storing things I use in my tinktures but when I opened the package one was broke and when I was washing them another broke with minimal pressure of just a normal hand washing.The jar feels like it’s made as cheap as possible. It seals poorly and does not contain smell or liquids in the jar properly. Will not buy again.These are not airtight. They leak and spoil contents that need an airtight container.
I bought them to make fermented garlic honey and homemade elderberry and within two days there was mold inside the container.
Such a waste of money.
